segments.name: CoreCivic Safety
segments.description: Owns, leases and manages correctional and detention facilities for government agencies, plus transportation services for governmental agencies.
segments.evidence: CoreCivic Safety segment, consisting of 44 correctional and detention facilities that are owned or controlled via a long-term lease and managed by CoreCivic, as well as those correctional and detention facilities owned by third parties but managed by CoreCivic.

segments.name: CoreCivic Community
products: electronic monitoring and case management services
segments.description: Operates residential reentry centers and provides electronic monitoring and case management for government agencies.
segments.evidence: CoreCivic Community segment, consisting of 20 residential reentry centers that are owned or controlled via a long-term lease and managed by CoreCivic.

segments.name: CoreCivic Properties
segments.description: Owns correctional real estate leased to government agencies under long-term lease agreements.
segments.evidence: CoreCivic Properties segment, consisting of five correctional real estate properties owned by CoreCivic held for lease to government agencies.

revenueModel.text: Government agencies pay a per diem for bed capacity and correctional, detention, and residential reentry services, and pay rent under long-term leases.
revenueModel.evidence: In our CoreCivic Safety and CoreCivic Community segments, we are compensated for providing bed capacity and correctional, detention, and residential reentry services at a per diem rate based upon actual or minimum guaranteed occupancy levels.
